# Baked Build specs + lab-loop traces

Committed, embedded Build specs (TECHSPEC §4, ADR-0007/0008). Two files per Task:

- `{blueprintId}_{taskId}_{contractHash}_{model}.json` — the approved Build spec
  (declarative geometry the headline replays).
- `{…}.trace.json` — the lab-loop trace sidecar (ADR-0008): the Build contract,
  every Generator↔Evaluator iteration (ops + layered verdict), and the outcome
  (`accepted`|`fallback`, `quality_flag`, reason). Audit data only — the headline
  never reads it.

Generated by the offline bake (the ONLY binary that reaches the Model seam):

    set -a; . ./.env; set +a
    go run ./cmd/bake -all                                  # bake the WHOLE dome
    go run ./cmd/bake -task foundation-1 -type foundation   # bake ONE task

`-all` bakes every demo Blueprint Task in dependency order (foundations → walls →
dome-cap), runs the Generator↔Evaluator refine loop per Task, and writes
`REVIEW.md` — the operator review listing any Tasks that fell back ∪ were cached
`quality_flag: low`.

These specs/traces are declarative geometry DATA, not secrets — they let the
headline replay generated specs deterministically with no API key and no model
call. The embedded cache (`embed.go`) loads only the spec `*.json` files; it skips
this README, `REVIEW.md`, and the `*.trace.json` sidecars.
